text.en: Item 114, paragraph "a," Title A, Section one of Republic Act Numbered Thirty-one hundred and one, entitled "An Act appropriating funds for public works, synchronizing the same with previous public works appropriations," is hereby deleted.

Under paragraph "b," Title A, Section one of the same Act, a new item is hereby inserted to read as follows:
"191. Bogo National Hospital, Bogo, Cebu ₱50,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
